description: Asks, on a writable copy, which names Database.CreateQueryDef(name, 'SELECT ID FROM One;') accepts, what Name then reads, and whether the query opens by that name: blank and padded names, names with a dot, bang, brackets, quotes, a semicolon, comma, wildcard, slash and colon, a leading tilde, hyphen, digit and #, the MSys and USys prefixes, 64 and 65 characters, non-Latin and astral characters, an embedded U+0000, tab and CR/LF, and the name of a table (One) and of a QueryDef differing only in case. At the end the QueryDefs Count and every name are read. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
